thought.text: Apache installed. Now extract the examples into `/var/www/html/examples` (matching the guide's expected URL layout) and verify the structure.

reasoning_content:
Apache is installed (in containers, services don't auto-start due to policy-rc.d, but I can start it manually).

The structure of the zip is as follows:
- basic/ (equivalent to "Basic/" in the guide)
- mastercode/3_27_1/

The guide mentions an `examples` folder wrapper, but the zip doesn't have that. Following the guide ("move the ZIP file to the web server and extract the archive"), I'll extract it as an `examples` folder under /var/www/html, so that the portal is placed at /var/www/html/examples/. This matches the URL pattern in the guide.

Wait — the guide says the portal should be at `https://[web-server-name]/examples/Basic/index.html`. If I extract so that the contents become `/var/www/html/examples/{basic,mastercode}`, then the URL path becomes `/examples/basic/index.html`. On a case-sensitive filesystem, "Basic" ≠ "basic", but the guide is just an example. The actual folder name inside the zip is lowercase `basic`. That's fine.

Alright, let's extract:
mkdir -p /var/www/html/examples && unzip -q examples.zip -d /var/www/html/examples/

Then verify the structure: /var/www/html/examples/basic/index.html, mastercode/3_27_1/js/masterportal.js, etc.

Next, start Apache: apachectl start or service apache2 start. In Docker without systemd, use `service apache2 start` or `apachectl -k start`.

After that, verify: curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost/examples/basic/index.html → expect 200. Also curl masterportal.js, config.js, config.json, services.json, style_v3.json.

Also, should I check whether index.html references the mastercode paths? Let me take a quick look at index.html and config.js after extraction.

First, let's do the extraction and structure verification.

action.command: mkdir -p /var/www/html/examples && timeout 120 unzip -q -o /workspace/examples.zip -d /var/www/html/examples/ && echo "UNZIP OK" && find /var/www/html/examples -maxdepth 2 | sort
